descriptions.w3d_d25b_matrix_euler_8009ea38: Matrix to Euler angles: rotates the X axis by the matrix, normalizes it (0x802e82c0), derives the angle about Y (asin 0x802e7c30 of z) and about Z (asin of y over the planar length, mirrored for negative x), rotates a copy of the matrix back by both (0x801f621c, 0x801f61a0), rotates the Y axis by the copy, normalizes it and derives the angle about X by quadrant, then writes x, y, z to the output vector.
